learning_outcomes.text: Express basic conservation laws in different forms.
Know the basic concepts of fluid kinematics and perform simple calculations.
Perform dimensional analysis and modeling for simple flow systems.
Perform differential flow analysis for simple one-dimensional flows.
Draw simple geometries in ANSYS environment for CFD, create numerical mesh, and define boundary conditions.
Perform single-phase laminar and turbulent flow simulations.
Perform flow visualization (post-processing) for simulated flow systems and interpret the results.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
ANSYS Fluent applications (Geometry and Numerical Mesh, boundary conditions)
ANSYS Fluent applications (Geometry and Numerical Mesh, boundary conditions)
ANSYS Fluent applications (Turbulent flow + heat transfer solutions)
ANSYS Fluent applications (Turbulent flow + heat transfer solutions)
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated from semester work (70%) and the final exam (40%). Semester work includes Assignment 1 (10%) and Assignment 2 (60%). The midterm exam contributes 60% to the internal grade and the final exam contributes 40% to the overall grade.
